lines.say: its sequence is reported to spur blood vessel growth (lab studies; never tested in people)
TB-500 itself, a piece of thymosin beta-4, showed no wound-healing effect (lab study)
possible immune reactions to the injected peptide, its clumps or impurities, FDA says
cancer risk unknown: no cancer studies, and lab work links it to blood vessel growth
skin and gum darkening after a BPC-157 blend, back on re-use (one report; cause unproven)

ask: Is there any human evidence for TB-500, as opposed to the full thymosin beta-4 protein?
